#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

int calculate(std::vector<char>& s, char x) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = x;
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') return 0;
    int result = 1;
    bool firstXEncountered = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            result *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
        } else if (s[i] == 'X' && firstXEncountered) {
            result *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
            firstXEncountered = false;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

bool isReplacePossible(const std::vector<char>& s, char a, char b) {
    size_t n = s.size();
    if (n < 2) return true; // Edge case, though in main code length >= 2
    if (s[n - 2] >= '0' && s[n - 2] <= '9' && s[n - 2] != a) return false;
    if (s[n - 1] >= '0' && s[n - 1] <= '9' && s[n - 1] != b) return false;
    if (s[n - 2] == 'X' && s[n - 1] == 'X' && a != b) return false;
    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    std::vector<char> s(input.begin(), input.end());

    if (s.size() < 2) {
        if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') {
            std::cout << 1 << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
        }
    } else {
        int totalWays = 0;
        std::vector<char> t;

        auto processReplacement = [&](char a, char b) {
            if (isReplacePossible(s, a, b)) {
                t = s;
                t[t.size() - 2] = a;
                t[t.size() - 1] = b;
                if (s[s.size() - 2] == 'X') {
                    totalWays += calculate(t, t[t.size() - 2]);
                } else if (s[s.size() - 1] == 'X') {
                    totalWays += calculate(t, t[t.size() - 1]);
                } else {
                    totalWays += calculate(t, 'X');
                }
            }
        };

        processReplacement('0', '0');
        processReplacement('2', '5');
        processReplacement('5', '0');
        processReplacement('7', '5');

        std::cout << totalWays << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
